The 15-language dictionaries cover concept titles, blurbs and UI strings, not teaching prose.

concepts.curriculum: GCSE Mathematics, algebra: function notation, composite functions, inverse functions, domain and range (Key Stage 4 to GCSE Higher)

concepts.curriculum: GCSE Mathematics, geometry and measures: trigonometric ratios in right-angled triangles; angles of elevation and depression (Key Stage 4 to GCSE Foundation and Higher)
